computer.title: Computer control
computer.note: Off until you start a session. The agent sees the screen and uses the mouse and keyboard only in apps you allow, and every click, keystroke and scroll asks for your approval. System settings, password managers, terminals, finance and identity apps and web browsers can never be controlled (web pages go through the Braavo browser).
computer.perm.screenWhy: Lets the agent see the screen. A screenshot goes only to the model you choose, with your own key; Braavolabs does not keep it.
computer.perm.accessibilityWhy: Lets the agent click, type and scroll, and lets the app check that it never types into a password field.
computer.restartNote: After you allow Screen Recording, quit and reopen Braavolabs.
computer.appsNote: Only the checked apps can be controlled. Apps that can never be controlled are greyed out.
computer.active: Braavo is controlling your computer · {actions}/{max} actions · {minutes}:{seconds} left
computer.startNote: A session ends after 15 minutes or 50 actions. Reading the screen asks once per session; every other action asks each time.
computer.notReady: Allow both permissions and check at least one app to start.
computer.unsupported: Computer control is available on macOS for now.

publish.none: No changes to prepare for publishing
publish.title: Get ready to publish
publish.branchBad: Use only letters, digits and . _ / - in the branch name.
publish.titleBad: The title is required and must fit on one line.
publish.secretText: These files are not sent. Remove them from the changes first: {names}
publish.confirmIntro: I will push this branch to this repository and open a PR:
publish.warn: This cannot be undone. The branch and PR are visible to everyone with access to the repository. I will not merge; you do that.
publish.noRepo: This folder has no github.com repository (origin). Publishing only works with github.com repositories.
publish.connectText: To open a PR I need your own GitHub access key.
publish.keyNote: The key is stored in the operating system keychain. It is not written to logs or chat.
publish.keyBad: This key does not look valid.
publish.keepOpen: Please keep this window open while it sends.
publish.doneNote: Nothing was merged. You merge it on GitHub.
publish.err.pushRejected: GitHub did not accept the branch. The changes are saved locally; nothing was merged. You can try again.
publish.err.network: You are offline. Nothing more was sent. Try again when the connection is back.
publish.err.noWriteAccess: No write access. The key you connected cannot write to this repository. Update the key, then try again.
publish.err.unauthorized: GitHub did not accept the key (expired or revoked). Update the key, then try again.
publish.err.notFound: GitHub cannot find this repository, or your key cannot see it. Check the key, then try again.
publish.err.rateLimit: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
publish.err.conflict: A PR for this branch may already exist, or GitHub found a conflict. Nothing was merged. Check GitHub.
publish.err.branchExists: A branch with this name already exists on this computer. Nothing changed. Change the branch name and try again.
publish.err.identity: Git does not know who you are yet (name and email). Set them in Git, then try again. Nothing changed.
publish.err.commitFailed: The changes could not be saved (a Git check may have refused them). Nothing was sent and your files are untouched. Fix the issue, then try again.
publish.err.wrongBranch: The branch changed since you confirmed. Nothing was sent. Start again.
publish.err.nothingToPublish: There is nothing to publish (no changes, or no commits between the branches).
publish.err.tooMany: Too many changed files to prepare in one go. Split the work into smaller parts.
publish.err.cancelled: Cancelled. The remaining steps were not run. You can try again.
publish.err.keychain: The key could not be saved to the operating system keychain, so it was not saved at all.
publish.err.invalid: The branch name or text is not valid. Nothing was sent.
publish.err.unknown: Something went wrong. Check what was done in the changes list, then try again.
publish.err.unsafeConfig: This repository's Git settings could redirect or weaken the upload (a proxy, another address or a hook). Nothing was sent. Remove those settings from the repository, then try again.
publish.err.gitAuth: Git could not sign in to GitHub for the upload, or your Git account cannot write to this repository. Set up your Git sign-in (the Git credential manager or an SSH key), then try again. The access key connected here is only used to open the PR and does not fix this. Nothing was merged.
publish.err.noPat: The branch is uploaded. To open the PR I need your GitHub access key. Connect it, then try again.
publish.err.changesChanged: The changed files are no longer the ones you confirmed. Nothing was sent. Look at the changes again, then start over.
